description: Address all 5 issues identified in semantic review: path traversal prevention, infinite recursion guards, interpolation escaping, HTMX injection for standalone templates, and partial recursion guard.
steps: Fix issue 1: Add path traversal validation in renderPartial and style-embed to verify resolved paths stay within viewsDir/staticDir
Fix issue 2: Add max depth guard (10) to resolveInheritance to prevent infinite recursion on cyclic extends
Fix issue 3: Set elemEscaped = true for interpolated element text in parser.nim so user-controlled data is escaped
Fix issue 4: Inject HTMX script in head element for standalone templates that have a head element (not just layouts)
Fix issue 5: Add depth limit (20) to renderPartial to prevent stack overflow from self-referencing partials
acceptance_criteria: Path traversal attempts (e.g., ../../etc/passwd) are rejected in partials and style-embed
Cyclic template extends does not cause stack overflow, instead returns an error comment
Interpolated text in elements is HTML-escaped by default
HTMX script is injected in standalone templates that have a head element
Recursive partials exceeding depth 20 return an error comment instead of stack overflow
